benchmark_metadata.methodology: Microbenchmark of transport serialization and IPC channel only

file_ipc.transport: File-based Atomic Swap (Raw filesystem transport only)
file_ipc.execution_mode: Sequential (1 client, 1 writer, in-memory FS cache)
file_ipc.caveat: Measures transport serialization and local OS file cache. Does NOT include REAPER's 15-33ms defer() loop tick or ReaScript execution latency.

socket_ipc.caveat: Measures loopback socket serialization. Does not include DAW audio thread dispatch or plugin load overhead.

websocket_ipc.execution_mode: Sequential async request-response over persistent ws connection
websocket_ipc.caveat: Measures asyncio event loop and WebSocket framing. Does not include DOM rendering in WebView.
